killReason: Market sizing: about 271 paying people and Rs 14,723 expected a year against a bar of Rs 3,00,000, with a 10% chance of working against a bar of 15%. Zoho Invoice and Refrens already send payment reminders free, and late payment hits most freelancers about once a year, so a one-time Rs 499 tool has little room. Stopped before any build.
title: Paychase
oneLiner: Polite payment reminder sequence and overdue tracker for Indian freelancers
customer: Indian freelancers with clients who pay late
